propositions: Agentic runs waste 40-70% of request budget by re-executing identical tool calls without memoization, with pathological cases looping 62-144 times on deterministic results.

Allowlisted read-only tools (read_file, search_files, list_directory, show_ticket) that return deterministic sentinel-empty results like '(no matches)' should be memoized and return cached results on duplicate signatures.
Error-prefixed results (e.g., 'Error: cannot read') must not be memoized and must re-execute on retry, since transient failures may yield different outcomes.
A memoization wrapper at the agent-call seam with nudge escalation (level-1 on first repeat, level-2 thereafter) steers models away from duplicate calls before the runaway guard backstop.
The wrapper operates within the existing runaway guard's signature-observation window so the distinct-ratio actuator continues to detect and abort pathological loops unchanged.
Concurrent tool calls in a single turn must be protected by per-signature asyncio.Lock to prevent race conditions between cache check and store.
